name: Palimpsest
description: Old selves show through like writing scraped off a page
behavioral_signature: Carries visible traces of every identity they've worn and shed
under_stress: Past selves resurface and compete for control
at_rest: A layered person whose history is readable in their contradictions
will_always: carry echoes of who they used to be
will_never: fully erase any previous version of themselves
unless: a past self is dangerous enough to require surgical removal
